decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to exclude accessories like cases, charging cables, and non-speaker items such as hats and earbuds. My consideration set focused on highly-rated portable speakers across different price points. The Bose SoundLink Color II stood out as the most reliable option due to its high rating (4.6) and massive volume of reviews (over 62,000), suggesting long-term consumer satisfaction. While the INSMY and NOTABRICK options offered interesting aesthetics and value, the brand trust and proven sound performance of the Bose made it the superior choice for a long-term purchase.
